dog.description_text:
Meet Bramble, a 10 year old, 15 pound, wonderful Yorkie mix. He is friendly and gets along with other dogs well!

Bramble has no teeth and will need to be on wet food for the rest of his life.

If you would like to adopt this dog, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
